title: paeonia yinpingmudan
intro: Paeonia yinpingmudan, commonly known as Yinpienmudan, is a type of orchid tree peony, a plant species native to China. It is valued for its medicinal properties, which include health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, helping to alleviate pain and promote wound healing. The therapeutic actions of Paeonia yinpingmudan include its ability to modulate the immune system, reduce fever, and alleviate menstrual cramps. The bioactive constituents of Paeonia yinpingmudan include alkaloids, flavonoids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
